module_summary: AXI-stream pipeline: LENGTH register stages forward data/valid and pipeline ready backward, terminated by a small output FIFO whose half-full flag provides ready so in-flight beats are absorbed.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload entering the first pipeline stage.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid qualified by ready into the valid pipeline.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready taken from the head of the delayed ready pipeline.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload from the FIFO output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from m_axis_tvalid_reg, set when FIFO non-empty.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready; clears output valid and permits FIFO reads.

anchors.name: stage[*].axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Per-stage data register; representative of forwarded tdata/tkeep/tlast/tuser stage registers.

anchors.name: stage[*].axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Per-stage valid register carrying beat validity forward.

anchors.name: stage[*].axis_tready_reg
anchors.why: Per-stage ready register delaying FIFO ready backward to s_axis_tready.

anchors.name: fifo.out_fifo_tdata
anchors.why: Output FIFO data RAM absorbing beats in flight in the pipeline.

anchors.name: fifo.out_fifo_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO write pointer addressing out_fifo arrays on pipeline output valid.

anchors.name: fifo.out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: FIFO read pointer addressing out_fifo arrays into the output register.

anchors.name: fifo.out_fifo_half_full_reg
anchors.why: Half-full flag; its inverse is ready fed into the ready pipeline.

anchors.name: fifo.out_fifo_empty
anchors.why: Empty flag blocking FIFO reads into output register.

anchors.name: fifo.m_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Last-stage valid acting as FIFO write enable.

groups.name: register_pipeline
groups.description: LENGTH stages registering forward payload/valid and backward ready.

groups.name: output_fifo
groups.description: Distributed-RAM FIFO with pointers and half-full ready generation.

groups.name: output_register
groups.description: Output registers loaded from FIFO driving AXI-stream output.
